# avahi / fuzz-packet

avahi's own fuzz target `fuzz-packet` ([source](source/fuzz-packet.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over avahi (avahi/avahi at b1a83592).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: same split -> join success contract without the service-name part.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against avahi at commit b1a83592.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- same split -> join success contract without the service-name part ([lines 67-69](source/fuzz-packet.c#L67-L69)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

## Statements ([Statements.v](Statements.v), [Characterise.v](Characterise.v), [Distribution.v](Distribution.v))

| statement | in one line | status |
|---|---|---|
| `plain_halts` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2; so the check above holds | open |
| `ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2; so the check above holds | open |
| `plain_halts_may_fail` | with no memory premise, and even if any request is refused at any time: the plain build exits with any status | open |
| `ubsan_halts_may_fail` | with no memory premise, and even if any request is refused at any time: the UBSan build exits with any status | open |
| `ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; UBSan never fires | open |
| `ubsan_disagrees_at_most` | P[plain and UBSan disagree] <= b under [Distribution.v](Distribution.v) | open (best proved b: none) |
| `ubsan_agreement_decidable` | some program decides exactly the inputs where plain and UBSan agree | open |

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch avahi` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz-packet.plain` | 71,120 | `33fd6a2db7f8f3cfe8890446dfb2a9e7c1dbaed769af7f01e804ef831667a054` |
| ubsan | `fuzz-packet.ubsan` | 73,120 | `c980784c5fcb44f45cddf84a3310af0c9dcdb2c0278679809ebb0a96aed5fab7` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
